blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate finance panel vice chair Sen. Pia Cayetano confirmed with the National Privacy Commission (NPC) on Wednesday whether it could investigate the publishing of her flight details. She inquired about the matter after her flight details were made public when she and her brother, Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano, took a trip to Singapore two weeks ago. “If a public official would say attend a function not necessarily aligned with their line of work but it can be said to be public because it’s not hiding… For example, I traveled to watch a national team perform and then the […]...
